applicant.name: Dr. Elena Marchetti
applicant.organisation: Vienna Heart Failure Registry Group, university hospital research unit

purpose: We study the sequence of hospital admissions and medication changes in patients with heart failure to build a time-to-readmission model that helps cardiology units plan follow-up care. The analysis needs the order of events within each patient; aggregated statistics cannot answer this.
question: Provide pseudonymised encounters, medications and conditions for adults with heart failure who had at least one inpatient stay in 2025. We will only export model coefficients and performance metrics.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Inpatient stay = encounter with type 'inpatient' starting in 2025.
Cohort = adults with heart failure who have at least one inpatient stay.
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
